req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update an existing player when a valid PUT request is made to the /players/{playerId} endpoint. The tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure the functionality is robust against common errors and edge cases.

tests.name: test_update_existing_player_success
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid PlayerRequestModel body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_update_player_squad_number_mismatch
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with a PlayerRequestModel body where squadNumber is 11.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_update_nonexistent_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 99 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/99 with a valid PlayerRequestModel body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "Player",
    "lastName": "Nonexistent",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 99,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/99", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 404
